messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — incoming customer request to onboard Nimble-4.5B (open 4.5B transformer) for a healthcare customer. They want FP16 + int8 evaluation and HIPAA-safe deployment. Need prioritization and quant smoke tests. @Ada can you take initial quant triage? :wave:
Ada Liu: On it. Do we have model artifacts (HF repo or tarball)? Also need a sample prompt set and the latency SLOs to plan perf runs.
Maria Chen: Customer shared HF snapshot: https://huggingface.co/nomodels/nimble-4.5b/tree/main and a 200-prompt eval set in GDrive (private link in ticket). Latency target: p95 <= 180ms on p4d for 512 tokens. Throughput is low. They'll accept int8 if quality delta <= 2% (rouge/accuracy).
Kevin Ortiz: Assigning to quant-queue. Quick checklist: 1) Verify model loads with transformers + accelerate; 2) Run FP16 baseline eval (perplexity / accuracy); 3) Convert to quant (bitsandbytes / GPTQ); 4) Run smoke eval + perf. Can someone confirm GPU availability for a canary run? @Sachin
Sachin Rao: We have a p4d-8x pool with 3 free instances this week. I'll reserve one for a quick quant smoke. Planning job flags: --max-seq 512 --batch 8.
Ada Liu: Note: model uses a custom rotary embedding naming. Might need a small state-dict rename patch. If HF load fails, fallback to ONNX conversion. I'll try HF load first.
Triage Bot: triage-bot created ticket INF-4829 and assigned to eng-ml/quant. Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-4829
Maria Chen: Could we run this quick smoke load to validate? ```python
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
import torch
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('nomodels/nimble-4.5b', torch_dtype=torch.float16)
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('nomodels/nimble-4.5b')
print(model.config)
``` Just want to catch any custom op/param naming issues early.
Ada Liu: Did the HF load on p4d. Saw a small mismatch: state dict keys use `rotary_emb_*` vs our loader expecting `rotary_embedding_*`. Fixed with a one-line rename in the checkpoint loader. FP16 baseline on the 200 prompts: perplexity 17.9, top-1 acc 74.2%. Starting GPTQ int8 run tonight (will try 4-bit then 8-bit).
Kevin Ortiz: Timeline: aim for canary quant + perf by EOD+2. Acceptance rule: int8 quality delta <= 2% vs FP16 on their metrics -> mark for dedicated onboarding. Also ensure HIPAA controls: Private deploy or Dedicated with VPC + KMS, logging retention policy.
Sachin Rao: Reserved p4d node for 48h, job names: `nimble-4p5b-fp16-baseline` and `nimble-4p5b-gptq-int8-smoke`. I'll attach run logs to INF-4829 when done.
Maria Chen: If Ada sees >2% drop, we'll escalate to model-ops for QAT/training-aware solutions. @Ada please append interim eval screenshots & sample outputs to the ticket.
Ada Liu: Will add artifacts to the ticket and GDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/nimble-evals. Posting intermediate loss curve & example generations once GPTQ completes.
Kevin Ortiz: Thanks all. If the smoke looks good, next step is a short Dedicated trial for perf validation before enabling Private deployment options.
Maria Chen: Great — keeping this thread for syncing. :thumbsup:
